circulars.subject: Live Activities Schedule
circulars.subject_full: Opening of Offer for Sale for KNOWLEDGE REALTY TRUST - Live Activities Schedule

movers.headline: signs a **long-term supply agreement with an unnamed leading hyperscaler** for high-density optical fibre cable across calendar 2027 to 2029, sized by the filing at **about USD 288 million**
movers.quantum: approximately USD 288 mn; the filing states no rupee equivalent

movers.headline: receives a **Letter of Acceptance from Rail Vikas Nigam worth Rs 602.16 crore including GST** for electro-mechanical works on four tunnels of the Rishikesh-Karnprayag rail line, over 30 months
movers.quantum: Rs 602.16 cr incl GST; ~19.0% of mcap

movers.headline: agrees to buy **nine land-owning companies holding an 84.7-acre platform at Najafgarh, Delhi**, discharging **up to Rs 420.23 crore** by issuing 70,33,162 shares at Rs 597.50 in a non-cash swap
movers.quantum: Rs 420.23 cr in shares; ~4.8% of mcap

movers.headline: board approves acquiring **about 99.99% of Ecogenics Technologies and Systems** for up to 41,07,42,006 shares at Rs 4.65, plus Rs 25.92 crore of preferential equity and warrants
movers.quantum: Rs 190.99 cr in swap shares (ours); ~231% of mcap (ours)

movers.headline: receives a **Letter of Acceptance of Rs 157.55 crore excluding GST from the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation** to build a flyover and an underpass at Banjara Hills, over 24 months
movers.quantum: Rs 157.55 cr excl GST; ~4.5% of mcap (ours)

movers.headline: board approves a **preferential issue of up to Rs 151.07 crore** — Rs 18.00 crore cash, the rest swap shares buying stakes in Cash & Carry Middle East and Interlink Distribution
wins a **Rs 117.88 crore contract from the DRDO, Ministry of Defence**, inclusive of taxes, to develop, install and commission a ground segment hub for voice and data communication
movers.quantum: Rs 117.88 cr incl taxes; ~2.8% of mcap

movers.headline: receives a purchase order from **Megha Engineering and Infrastructures** for transformers, sized only as a **"Large Order" on its own published scale of Rs 100-500 crore excluding GST**
board approves an **Rs 85.00 crore preferential issue of 16,89,859 shares at Rs 503** to ICICI Prudential SmallCap Fund, ICICI Prudential Retirement Fund and Clarus Capital II
board approves buying **100% of Blisstering Electronics and Bliss Cab Electronics** for up to 5,67,51,732 shares at Rs 14, and lifts authorised capital from Rs 7.5 crore to Rs 64 crore

receives **multiple purchase orders aggregating Rs 67.14 crore** for prefabricated steel structures from a buyer the filing names only as India's largest diversified conglomerate, for delivery by March 2027
wins a **Rs 30,36,79,635 work order from NHAI**, on competitive bidding, to act as user-fee agency for one year at the Manambadi plaza on the Sethiyathope-Cholapuram section of NH-36 in Tamil Nadu
secures a **work order of Rs 10.09 crore including GST from Eastern Railway's Liluah workshop** to alter the electrical systems of 658 LHB three-tier coaches over 36 months
movers.quantum: Rs 10.09 cr incl GST; ~4.5% of mcap

business_updates: **Results season** — 7 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Elgi Equipments** — its US subsidiary receives a further **tariff refund of US$ 1.55 million, about Rs 14.82 crore on the filing's own conversion**, from US Customs and Border Protection following the US Supreme Court's directive on excess tariff collected from importers.
**Ather Energy** — marks its fourth Ather Community Day by launching the Konarc, alongside changes to vehicle health, batteries and charging.
**Aayush Wellness** — a press release announcing entry into respiratory healthcare with lung-care tablets aimed at smoking-exposed and respiratory-concerned consumers.
capex_core: **NLC India** — its JV NIRL NCRTC Renewables, 74% held by NLC India Renewables and 26% by the National Capital Region Transport Corporation, signs a **25-year power purchase agreement for a 110 MW solar project in Uttar Pradesh** on captive terms, with 180 MU of annual generation required and commissioning due within 24 months.
distress_risk: **R R Kabel** — receives a **Show Cause-cum-Demand Notice from the DGGI's Surat Zonal Unit under Sections 74(1) and 122(1)**, covering financial years 2020-21 to 2023-24; the notice states no amount in the disclosure.

**Ram Ratna Wires** — receives a **Show Cause-cum-Demand Notice from the same DGGI Surat Zonal Unit for financial years 2020-21 to 2023-24**, a matching action against a second RR Global company on the same day, with no amount disclosed.
**JSW Cement** — receives a **show cause notice from the Joint Commissioner of State Tax, CT & GST Circle, Jajpur**, dated the same day, and says it is preparing its reply.
**Godavari Biorefineries** — intimates receipt of a **show-cause notice**, filed under pendency of litigation or dispute.
**Jyoti Ltd** — intimates **receipt of an NCLT order**.
equity_allotments: **Parmax Pharma** — allots **31,37,586 equity shares at Rs 36.50, aggregating Rs 11,45,21,889**, to fourteen non-promoter allottees, together with 21,45,145 convertible warrants convertible within 18 months (a fresh preferential allotment now executed) _(~23.3% of mcap)_.

**JHS Svendgaard Retail Ventures** — allots **23,01,000 fully convertible warrants at Rs 25** to non-promoters on a preferential basis, taking Rs 6.25 a warrant up front, under the April board and May EGM approvals (new warrants; Rs 5.75 crore is our multiplication of the count by the price).
**Shree Karni Fabcom** — allotment by circular resolution of **1,05,000 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs 10 each on conversion of fully convertible warrants** (a past conversion, not new capital).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Virtuoso Optoelectronics** — board approves a preferential issue of **16,89,859 equity shares at Rs 503, aggregating Rs 84,99,99,077**, for cash to **ICICI Prudential SmallCap Fund (Rs 55.00 cr), ICICI Prudential Retirement Fund-Hybrid Aggressive Plan (Rs 15.00 cr) and Clarus Capital II (Rs 15.00 cr)**, subject to an EGM on 24 September _(~4.7% of mcap)_.

**Salem Erode Investments** — board approves a **rights issue of up to 1,14,65,520 equity shares at Rs 20, aggregating up to Rs 22.93 crore**, one-for-one, with a record date of 3 September and the issue open 15 to 25 September _(~59% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Kshitij Polyline** — files a corrigendum extending the closing date of its **Rs 19.56 crore rights issue of 6,16,97,950 shares** from 4 September to 9 September, a five-day extension with no change to size or price.

**Sampre Nutritions** — receives BSE in-principle approval to issue **17,70,710 equity shares of Rs 5 at not less than Rs 42** to the promoter and promoter group against conversion of unsecured loans.
m_and_a: **Max Estates** — board approves acquiring the entire interest in **nine land-owning companies holding an approximately 84.7-acre platform at Sector 3, Najafgarh, Delhi**, discharging the consideration through a preferential issue of up to **70,33,162 shares at Rs 597.50, aggregating Rs 4,20,23,14,295**, for consideration other than cash _(~4.8% of mcap)_.

**CCME Global** — board approves buying **more than 50% of Cash & Carry Middle East FZCO (Rs 112,72,50,000 in swap shares) and 52% of Interlink Distribution LLC (Rs 20,34,22,490)**, alongside Rs 18.00 crore of cash subscription shares at Rs 10, and a ten-for-one share split _(Rs 151.07 crore across the three legs, our sum; ~84% of mcap)_.

**Ishaan Infrastructures and Shelters** — board approves acquiring **100% of Blisstering Electronics and Bliss Cab Electronics** under a Share Swap Agreement, issuing up to **5,67,51,732 shares at Rs 14** for consideration other than cash, and raising authorised capital from Rs 7.50 crore to Rs 64.00 crore _(Rs 79.45 crore, our multiplication; about twelve times its market value)_.

**Variman Global Enterprises** — board approves acquiring **about 99.99% of Ecogenics Technologies and Systems** on a 27.45:1 swap, issuing up to **41,07,42,006 shares at Rs 4.65**, plus 1,67,32,245 preferential shares and 3,90,00,000 warrants at the same price _(Rs 190.99 crore and Rs 25.92 crore respectively, our multiplications)_.

**Tata Chemicals** — its subsidiary Tata Chemicals North America is declared successful bidder in the **Chapter 11 proceedings of Searles Valley Minerals** for North American soda ash customer contracts covering over 500,000 metric tonnes to December 2028, for **cash consideration of USD 21.16 million**, which it expects to generate revenue above USD 110 million.
**Heritage Foods** — an update on its acquisition of **5.60% of the equity share capital of Heritage Novandie Foods**, its French-partnered yoghurt joint venture.

**Aster DM Quality Care** — approves amalgamating **KIMSHEALTH Executive Leisure (Rs 1.47 crore turnover) into Spiceretreat Hospitality Services (Rs 77.15 crore)**, both step-down subsidiaries, with an appointed date of 1 April 2026.
order_wins: **Sterlite Technologies** — a **long-term supply agreement with a "Leading hyperscaler"** for high-density optical fibre cable allocated by calendar year from 2027 to 2029, extendable by two years, sized in the filing at **approximately USD 288 million**; no rupee equivalent is stated.

**Ashoka Buildcon** — a **Letter of Acceptance of Rs 602.16 crore including GST from Rail Vikas Nigam**, dated 28 August, for Package-3 electro-mechanical works on tunnels T-13 to T-16 of the Rishikesh-Karnprayag new broad-gauge line in Uttarakhand, over 30 months _(~19.0% of mcap)_.

**KNR Constructions** — a **Letter of Acceptance of Rs 157,54,60,000 excluding GST from the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation** for a two-lane flyover at NFCL Junction and an underpass with a three-lane flyover at TV9 Junction, Banjara Hills, on EPC terms over 24 months _(~4.5% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Avantel** — a **Rs 117.88 crore contract from the DRDO, Ministry of Defence**, inclusive of taxes, for development, installation and commissioning of a ground segment hub for voice and data communication, to be executed by February 2029 with a 36-month warranty _(~2.8% of mcap)_.

**Transformers and Rectifiers (India)** — a purchase order from **Megha Engineering and Infrastructures** for manufacture of transformers and related work, delivery within 35 months; the filing states the size only as a **"Large Order"**, its own band of Rs 100-500 crore excluding GST _(~1.1-5.5% of mcap on that band, our arithmetic)_.

**Karbonsteel Engineering** — **multiple purchase orders aggregating Rs 67.14 crore** for prefabricated steel structures, from a buyer the filing identifies only as India's largest diversified conglomerate spanning energy, petrochemicals, telecom, retail and digital services, for delivery by 3 March 2027 _(~44.8% of mcap)_.

**GP Eco Solutions India** — amends its July-2025 EPC contract for a 24 MWac / 31.67 MWdc Punjab solar project: Welkin Renewable is replaced by end customers Garg Acrylics and Nahar Industrial, and the aggregate value falls **from about Rs 121.92 crore to Rs 76.85 crore** as land, transmission and some modules leave its scope _(a Rs 45.07 crore reduction, our subtraction; ~9.3% of mcap)_.

**Innovision** — a **Rs 30,36,79,635 work order from NHAI**, won on competitive bidding, to act as user-fee agency at the Manambadi plaza on the Sethiyathope-Cholapuram section of NH-36 in Tamil Nadu for one year, with upkeep of the adjacent toilet blocks _(~5.2% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Dhara Rail Projects** — a **Rs 10,08,64,683 work order including GST** from the Dy. Chief Mechanical Engineer (Electrical), Eastern Railway's Liluah carriage and wagon workshop, to alter the electrical systems of 658 LHB three-tier coaches over 36 months _(~4.5% of mcap; SME)_.
other_notable: **Timex Group India** — receives **Form GST ASMT-12 from the Superintendent, CGST Noida, dropping all proceedings** arising from the show cause notice of 25 May, with no further action required.
